issues.title: Article publication
issues.verification: Identify which roles can publish a draft article.
issues.rationale: An editor can check each article before publication.
issues.evidence: SPEC.md, Publication: articles require editorial review before publication.
issues.strategic_impact_reason: The publishing role controls who can release content.
issues.cost_reason: Changing the role later requires permission and workflow changes.
issues.externally_observable_reason: Authors see whether they can publish an article.
